programs.title: Bloomberg Surveillance
programs.desc: Jonathan Ferro, Lisa Abramowicz and Annmarie Hordern have the economy and global markets "under surveillance"; their daily conversations with leaders and decision makers from Wall Street to Washington and beyond cover the latest in business, investment, and geopolitics; no other program better positions investors and executives for the trading day.

programs.title: Bloomberg Open Interest
programs.desc: Delivering the market-moving news anyone needs to know to get a jump start on the U.S. trading day.

programs.title: Bloomberg Tech
programs.desc: Bloomberg Tech is the only daily live technology program with a focus on breaking news, market-moving reporting and analysis of global technology companies and stories. The program brings the audience interviews from the biggest names in the business, offering in-depth analysis and critical insights.

programs.title: Bloomberg Money
programs.desc: Breaking news and projections before the start of the business day.

programs.title: Bloomberg Businessweek Daily
programs.desc: Carol Massar and Tim Stenovec bring reporting from the magazine that helps global leaders stay ahead, plus insight on the people, companies and trends shaping today's complex economy.

programs.title: Bloomberg: The Close
programs.desc: Romaine Bostick and Katie Greifeld break down the day's top market-moving stories and trading action around the closing bell.

programs.title: Bloomberg: Balance of Power
programs.desc: "Bloomberg Balance of Power" with host David Westin is a daily look at how politics is impacting global business decisions; top lawmakers, business executives and government leaders join to discuss doing business in today's volatile political climate.

programs.title: Bloomberg Wall Street Week
programs.desc: A weekly program telling the stories of capitalism from around the world, David Westin in New York hosts.

programs.title: Bloomberg New Economy
programs.sub_title: Thriving in an Age of Extremes
programs.desc: Candid conversations with CEOs, investors, and government leaders focused on how to navigate and prosper in this age of economic uncertainty. Hosted by Erik Schatzker in Singapore.

programs.title: The Mishal Husain Show
programs.desc: Mishal Husain brings her signature blend of curiosity and tenacity to weekly conversations with world leaders, business titans and cultural icons, revealing who they really are and how they see the world changing around them.

programs.title: Leaders with Francine Lacqua: The Podcast
programs.sub_title: Kristalina Georgieva on the IMF's Role as Global Truth Teller
programs.desc: Francine speaks with International Monetary Fund Managing Director Kristalina Georgieva about the IMF's role as a truth teller for the global economy, the importance of trust in making difficult reforms and why leaders must protect the most vulnerable while preparing for a world of repeated shocks.

programs.title: Leaders with Francine Lacqua: The Podcast
programs.sub_title: Rolls-Royce CEO Tufan Erginbilgiç on Transforming a British Icon
programs.desc: Francine Lacqua speaks with Rolls-Royce Chief Executive Officer Tufan Erginbilgiç about confronting the company's weaknesses with data-driven honesty and setting a clear, granular strategy to transform performance and culture; he reflects on the responsibility of restoring one of Britain's most important industrial brands.
